name: Decision Fatigue
axiom: Decision quality degrades over a long session of repetitive choices.
trigger: A flow reaches its twelfth configuration question, and the last three answers were left at the default.
checklist: Batch small choices into one review step instead of asking them one at a time.
Defer non-critical configuration until the main task is finished.
Pre-populate safe defaults so most questions need no answer.

antiPattern.violation: An onboarding flow asks twenty separate configuration questions before the first task, each with no default.
antiPattern.remediation: One review screen batches the questions, defers the optional half, and pre-fills safe defaults.

parametricParams.caption: QUALITY FALLS ACROSS A LONG SESSION

academicOrigin.title: Ego Depletion: Is the Active Self a Limited Resource?
academicOrigin.publication: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 74(5), 1252-1265
